title: fix: honor preview_n for directory previews
request: inspect_bio_file currently returns five directory entries regardless of preview_n. Make directory previews honor preview_n, including zero and a value greater than five, while preserving the existing bounded scan and file behavior. Add regression coverage.
acceptance: Directory previews return at most preview_n entries; preview_n=0 returns an empty preview; preview_n=8 can return eight entries from a directory containing ten files. sampled_entries remains the bounded scanned count. Existing tests pass. Do not change the allowed range of preview_n or weaken tests.
